title: Roblox Innovation Awards
text: Mini War, a Roblox game I contributed to as a developer for Fair Entertainment, won Best Strategy Experience at the 2026 Roblox Innovation Awards, presented at RDC 2026.

images.alt: Winner graphic: Mini War, Best Strategy Experience
Nomination graphic: Mini War nominated for Best Strategy Experience at the Roblox Innovation Awards 2026

title: Roblox x PGA Challenge
text: Took second place and received a certificate of recognition from Roblox in the challenge held with Poznań Game Arena 2025, where experiences were built from scratch around Polish culture, traditions, places and legends. At the event, Ruben Veiga presented me with the award, and after the ceremony I joined a focus group with him, where we talked about Roblox's future tech.
